title: Compounding Systems
hook: Posting once doesn't do much. Posting every week for a year changes everything.
statement: Small actions repeated consistently add up to huge results. The payoff comes from not breaking the chain.
explainer: Compounding is boring week to week and wild in hindsight. Every time you break the streak, you reset the base and lose the growth you'd built.
sop: Pick one action to build a streak on: content, savings, or practice.
Estimate your realistic Rate of improvement per period.
Set a minimum version you can do even on bad days.
Track your streak, your Time, somewhere you'll see it daily.
Review quarterly. Growth hides week to week.
equation_example: Base 100, Rate 5% per period, Time 12 periods. 100 × 1.05 to the 12th power ≈ 180. That's 80% more from small steady gains. Higher means your streak is stacking up. Lower means breaks keep resetting it.
question: Name one small action you keep breaking the streak on, and write its minimum daily version.
closing_statement: A broken streak resets more than it looks like.
